title: AshaPure
description: A MERN dairy e-commerce platform supporting shopping, checkout, orders, subscriptions, rewards and admin operations.
story: A MERN dairy e-commerce platform supporting shopping, checkout, orders, subscriptions, rewards and admin operations. I owned it end to end: schema, routes, auth and the UI.

The hardest part wasn't a single feature, it was making all of them agree: an order touches inventory, a subscription touches billing, a reward touches both. Keeping that consistent is what the route and endpoint count really represents.

title: Arena Self-Driving
description: A reinforcement learning simulator where an agent learns to drive with tabular SARSA.
story: A reinforcement learning simulator where an agent learns to drive with tabular SARSA, on a highway with other cars, using a discretized state space.

I recorded my own driving as human demonstrations and used them to warm-start training, so the agent didn't learn from nothing. Training metrics stream to the browser live, so I can watch the policy improve instead of guessing from a log file.
